subtitle: Unofficial demo. Replies come from a fixed FAQ list.
welcome: Hello! This is an unofficial demo built from the Landlord Property Management website. Ask about applying, paying rent, deposits, pets or office hours, or leave an enquiry.
hoursNote: Closed on the holidays listed on the contact page. Source: the contact page.

services.name: Rentals and tenant questions
services.description: Ask about applying, deposits, rent, pets, utilities and repairs. Details come from the Tenant FAQs page.

services.name: Property management for owners
services.description: The website has pages about owner services and pricing. Please contact the team for details.

questions: How do I reach you?
What is your phone number?
faqs.answer: Email is best (propmanager@landlordpm.com). You can also call the main line on 210-492-1695 and leave a message, or the leasing line on 210-775-6263.

questions: Can you hold a place before I apply?
Can you hold a property for me?
faqs.answer: No. Once you apply, properties can only be held for two weeks after a deposit is paid.

questions: How do I apply for a home?
How do I apply to rent?
faqs.answer: All application procedures start from the listings: click the property picture and use the HOW TO APPLY button. Applications are taken in the order received. If you have an issue, use the ask-a-question box under the property.

questions: How long does an application take?
When will I hear about my application?
faqs.answer: Staff can usually respond in 1 to 3 business days, depending on weekends and holidays. A formal response is usually sent by email.

questions: How old do I have to be to apply?
Does every adult need to apply?
faqs.answer: All adults 18 years or older must apply, even if they will not be the main leaseholder.

questions: How much is the security deposit?
Is the deposit refundable?
faqs.answer: Approved applicants pay a refundable security deposit at lease signing of $25.00 less than the monthly rent, due within 48 hours of approval. You do not pay first and last month's rent with it; rent is pro-rated from your move-in date. The goal is a full refund, minus carpet cleaning, which is an automatic deduction.

questions: How do I pay rent?
Can I pay in person?
faqs.answer: You can pay rent through your portal by e-check or credit card. You can also download a pay slip to pay in person at places like CVS or HEB.

questions: When is my rent due?
What is the late fee?
faqs.answer: Rent is due on the 1st of each month. The late fee is 10% of the month's rent, starting on the 4th. Payments go first to late fees, maintenance fees or administrative fees, and then to rent.

questions: Can I have a pet?
What is the pet deposit?
faqs.answer: Notify the property manager before getting a pet, complete a pet profile on landlordpm.petscreening.com and sign a pet agreement. The pet deposit is $500 per pet. The screening criteria say no pets over 40 pounds and a maximum of 2 pets per household.

questions: Who pays for utilities?
Who is responsible for water and electricity?
faqs.answer: The tenant is responsible for water, electric, cable and internet. Properties in the Bulverde area have separate billing for sewer service.

questions: How do I submit a repair request?
What do I do about maintenance?
faqs.answer: Submit repair requests through the tenant portal for the fastest response. You can also email the repairs address given on the site, which is monitored during regular business hours.

questions: What if I have an emergency after hours?
Who do I call for urgent repairs?
faqs.answer: For after-hours or immediate service requests there is a 24-hour answering service on 210.988-0378. It is for emergency calls only; non-emergency repairs should go through the portal or repair line.

questions: What about trash service?
How do I get mailbox access?
faqs.answer: For trash, check your city's website if service is city-provided; some areas use private companies. For mailbox access, take a copy of your lease to the nearest post office, which will re-key the box; there is typically a charge.
